decision_text.text: Given this incident, if you think the probability of the severe outcome (issuer_total: loss 99.87% of equity) is above 0.491%, exit the sellable 45.00% now (cost 0.491% of value sold, gas included); the other 55.00% cannot be sold through the pool now. With the partial outcome at its default 26.69%, exiting the sellable part already pays at any severe probability. If the severe loss is only 50.00% (issuer_half), the threshold is 0.982%.
